title: Manual Child Ticket Re-Apportionment Console
precondition: Sub-account #5 order failed due to broker bridge glitch during block fill.
steps: 1. Ops engineer opens 'MAM Ticket Reconciliation Console'.2. Selects parent order and clicks 'Re-Apportion Child Ticket #5'.
expected_result: Child ticket created manually with original execution price; sub-account P&L restored perfectly.
actual_result: Reconciliation console allows operations engineers to manually re-apportion child tickets using parent order execution price.
